title.zh: 企业 AI 基础设施正转化为收入
title.en: Enterprise AI infrastructure converts to revenue

thesis.zh: 云业务增长是目前最清晰的验证点：关注 AI 基础设施需求是否持续，以及投入回报能否高于新增产能成本。
thesis.en: Cloud growth is the clearest current proof point: focus on whether AI infrastructure demand persists while returns stay above the cost of incremental capacity.

title.zh: 分发能力将模型变成产品经济
title.en: Distribution turns models into product economics

thesis.zh: 既有工作流与消费者生态，是从模型能力走向经常性收入和留存的高质量路径。
thesis.en: Installed workflows and consumer ecosystems are the highest-quality path from model capability to recurring revenue and retention.

title.zh: 消费 IP 仍需验证可复制性

thesis.zh: 对 Pop Mart，下一项估值判断是全球需求能否跨 IP、跨地区扩展，而非依赖单一爆款。
thesis.en: For Pop Mart, the next underwriting question is whether global demand broadens across IPs and regions rather than relying on one breakout franchise.
